description:
In the third period of Game 2 against the Boston Bruins, Erik Karlsson — the dynamic defenseman and offensive wizard for the Ottawa Senators — produced an incredible assist that tied the game and shifted the momentum in the series.
With the score 3-2 late in regulation, Karlsson took the puck and took the Bruins for a skate, dazzling defenders with his elite skating and stickhandling before delivering a perfect feed to Derick Brassard for the tying goal.
Karlsson’s highlight-reel assist sparked Ottawa’s comeback in an overtime victory that prevented the Bruins from taking a 2-0 series lead and the Senators losing the first two games at home. Ottawa would go on to close out the series in six games, with Karlsson’s magic helping set the tone for one of the most memorable playoff runs in franchise history. Despite not playing in the Stanley Cup Final (the team lost in the Eastern Conference Final), Karlsson led all NHL defensemen in assists (16) and points (18) during the 2017 Stanley Cup Playoffs.
